bio.text: Melissa Bean represented Illinois' 8th Congressional District from 2005 to 2011, losing her seat to Joe Walsh by a few hundred votes.
After returning to the private sector, she launched her own consulting firm and worked at JPMorgan Chase and Mesirow Financial; she won the Democratic primary for the same district on March 17, 2026.

sources.title: Melissa Bean Declared Winner in Democratic Primary for Krishnamoorthi's Open 8th Congressional District Seat
